flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: workflows/datahiveuenfin (DataHiveUenFinService), services/datahive/nricFinUenDataRetrieval/service/DataHiveUENBatchService, crud OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.findToppanNoticesForStage, workflows/agencies/toppan/upload (ToppanStage, ToppanUploadJob), application-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code specific to this story
note: 1-point story, status 'Requirement given - Gen flow' (not verified). No code replaces the notice owner with the Director/Partner or moves the stage back to RD1 from the UEN lookup result. Only DataHive data receipt (partly, board not stored) and generic RD1 letter generation exist. The UEN job is off in prod; the Toppan upload is blocked by config (OCMS-DF-2026-192).
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The logic to switch the owner to the Director/Partner and revert to RD1 is missing; only the generic RD1 letter exists.

steps.step: OCMS receives the individual Director/Partner particulars
steps.detail: Same as OCMS12.12 step 4: the DataHive result carries shareholderData and boardData (BATCH:196-210). Shareholders are saved (SVC:1442-1448) without appointment dates; board data is only logged and not written to the DB (OCMS-DEV-2026-231, SVC:1468-1478). The UEN job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:52). The name 'DOS' is not in code: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice's vehicle owner is changed to the individual Director/Partner
steps.detail: The only active patch to ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver from the UEN flow is updateCompanyName(), which only replaces the name column with the entity name (SVC:1798-1814). No code writes the Director/Partner's id_no/name/address as the notice offender. grep director/partner in workflows/datahiveuenfin: no hit.

steps.step: The notice is reverted to stage RD1 (1st reminder)
steps.detail: No code changes next_processing_stage from the UEN lookup result: DataHiveUenFinService only writes company name, address, shareholders and applies TS-ACR suspensions (de-registered, UEN not found, mandatory data missing) (SVC:1346-1480); next_processing_stage is only read (SVC:226, 310). Stage RD1 exists in ToppanStage (STAGE:19-21) but is reached only through the normal sequence or other paths (for example the ENA patch to RD1), not through the UEN lookup result.

steps.step: The 1st reminder letter (stage RD1) is created and sent to the individual Director/Partner
steps.detail: Letter generation for notices with next_processing_stage='RD1' exists (findToppanNoticesForStage, VonRepository:583-614; ToppanStage:19-20) and runs generically for any offender. But the letter only goes to the offender already recorded on the notice; since the owner is never replaced (step 2), this mechanism is not specific to the Director/Partner. Upload to Toppan is blocked by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86; ticket OCMS-DF-2026-192 still Ready to UAT). Real delivery: cannot verify from repo.
